name: a general store seen flat from the front: a cream striped wall, a long wooden counter with a pile of banknote bricks under a dark total board, a wall calendar, a shelf of phones that runs past the frame, jerrycans on the floor and a scooter parked beside the counter, cut by the frame
fits: anything about what an amount of money buys: a price compared with everyday goods, a budget counted in phones, motorbikes, litres of petrol or monthly wages; the hero is the pile of money on the counter, the camera pans from one kind of goods to the next
recipe: flat 2D front view (no iso), one scale of 11 px a cm: a wall rect with stripes and a floor band that bleed past the frame, a taupe counter with a top slab and panels, the pile as a grid of green bricks with white paper bands, a framed dark board with the total in mono, phones as dark rounded rects on three shelf boards, jerrycans as grey cans with a pressed X, a side-view scooter in greys cut by the frame, a white wall calendar with a grey header; no meaning colours in the dressing
